releaseNotes:
• AirPods-Style Update Dialog: Full-screen edge-to-edge window configuration with navbar liquid glass UI preventing bottom clipping
• Mini Player Seekbar Haptics & Time Bubble: Mechanical tactile ticks on touch-down, continuous ticks per second change, release confirmation, and organic time bubble floating above the mini player
• Next Up Controls & Queue Styling: Clean pill UI matching Next Up button (frosted white active, translucent glass inactive without harsh borders)
• Performance & Audio Engine: Real-time seek responsiveness and fluid gesture transitions
